scope: source observational audit only; no model imports, fitting, parameter inference or source edits

sources.source_title: Data from 56 fungicide trials in wheat fields across Europe 2017-2019
Data from 168 fungicide trials in wheat fields across Europe 2014-2018

definitions.candidate: source INFECT; BASF Method=P%INF; disease codes retained
definitions.eligible: every raw value 0<=Value<=100, consistent source Field year, no BASF CROP INJURY annotation; whole field/date/code/organ/treatment-key assessment excluded when invalid
definitions.assessment_grain: source×field×date×original_code×source_organ×Treatment×TreatmentCode; mean retains all raw rows; denominator is source-row count, not biological replicate count
definitions.repeated_field: at least two or three distinct eligible dates in field and disease family; disease scores are not pooled across organs
definitions.ranked_leaf_repeat: same field×original_code×source ordinal leaf assessed on at least two or three distinct dates; source code strata never merged into numeric scores
definitions.complete_top3: all source leaf ranks 1,2,3 observed on each date for one original code; at least two or three such dates
definitions.zero: explicit Value=0; source absence/missing code not converted to zero
definitions.zero_only: all eligible observations in the observed window zero; does not identify complete-season disease absence
definitions.geography: published coordinates rounded to 0.1 degree; disjoint values do not establish biological site independence
definitions.yield_match: field×actual Treatment×TreatmentCode; raw yield metrics and source units kept separate; no inferred plot, replicate or protected control
definitions.BASF_yield_relative_response: MCALCR source relative yield index is algebraically checked against 100×MWCGS_treated/MWCGS_untreated within TrialId; per-trial ratio does not require inferred mass units or imply fully protected controls.

taxonomy.ERYSGA: oat-specific mildew code, excluded from wheat mildew family; source conflict unresolved

limitations: Sowing, cultivar, seed-treatment, plot and biological replicate identities absent from both raw archive tables.
Corteva disease INFECT row metric units and denominator unspecified; repeated equal rows retained.
BASF P%INF indicates a percentage domain with unspecified incidence/severity denominator.
TreatmentCode and Applications identify source labels and are not interpreted as observed protected plots or full fungicide efficacy.
BASF2019 and strict Corteva143 observations already exposed to prior model evaluation; disease-specific source exposure beyond STB is not certified as untouched.
A location-year is a rounded public coordinate/year, not an exact biological experimental unit.
Source-specific wheat taxon labels remain separate; broad-species source labels do not establish isolate identity.
Corteva TreatmentCode is not a unique biological arm: treated YIELD in 14 fields has multiple NumSprays under the same Field/TreatmentCode. Product identities and plot IDs are absent.
